items.html: *Know that there is one difference between the Mochin at the time of pregnancy and the Mochin of nursing and Gadlut. For although it was clarified above that the Mochin of Gadlut are the principal ones, being the mercies, and the Katnut, which is of pregnancy and nursing, is alike in being judgments, still there is a difference between them, for necessarily one ascends from degree to degree, and the degree of nursing is greater than that of pregnancy, and it has an addition in praise over that of pregnancy.
